unitTitle: B2 · TCF speaking Task 2: get the information you need
title: Listening practice
subtitle: B2 · Unit 11: B2 · TCF speaking Task 2: get the information you need

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Le tarif comprend les outils, mais pas le cahier. Les participants peuvent apporter le leur ou en acheter un sur place.
steps.question: What is not included in the price?
steps.explain: The speaker says the workbook is not included.

steps.fr: Pourriez-vous me dire à quelle date la prochaine séance commence ? Elle commence le 12, si la salle reste disponible.
steps.question: What condition affects the date?
options: Whether the learner brings a workbook
steps.explain: The date depends on the room's availability.

steps.fr: La réservation est facultative, mais elle permet de recevoir un rappel. Si vous choisissez de venir sans réserver, vérifiez l'horaire avant de vous déplacer.
steps.question: Why might someone reserve?
steps.explain: A reservation allows the participant to receive a reminder.
